name: Pacific Medical Prosthetics & Orthotics
old_description: Delivering Better Orthopedic Outcomes—One Patient, One Provider at a Time.
about:
Pacific Medical, Inc. was founded in 1987 by John Petlansky and is headquartered in Tracy, California. The company began with roots in eight western states and has grown into a nationally recognized distributor and service provider in the durable medical equipment space, focusing on orthopedic rehabilitation and surgical orthopedics.

The company operates 15 orthotic and prosthetic patient care facilities and 40 satellite offices across 18 western states. Its team comprises over 400 professionals, including more than 200 internal staff and a dedicated external sales and service force of over 215. Pacific Medical runs four divisions: OrthoLIFE, a proprietary patient-centered orthopedic rehabilitation and recovery platform; Surgical, providing innovative solutions for orthopedic and surgical care; Biologics, delivering advanced regenerative and biologic products; and Top Shelf Orthopedics, supporting product design, management, and distribution within the orthopedic space.

Pacific Medical serves healthcare providers, hospitals, and patients across the orthopedic continuum. Its customer base includes hospitals and clinical practices in 18 states, with the company reporting 540,000 lives changed in the most recent year. The firm specializes in orthopedic rehabilitation, arthroscopic surgery, sports medicine, prosthetics, and orthotics, positioning itself as a trusted extension of its partners' practices.

The company emphasizes enduring partnerships built on trust, responsiveness, and a shared dedication to improving the quality of patient care. Its OrthoLIFE platform is designed to streamline care, improve outcomes, and support the unique needs of each facility, reflecting a stated commitment to innovation with integrity and partnerships with purpose.
